verdict.rationale: a-Shell is an iOS terminal app, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no MCP server. Its only programmatic surfaces are Apple Shortcuts actions and an optional HTTPS relay that accepts POST /run commands, which are adjacent automation hooks rather than an MCP server an agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
